description:
Found by specled_-dn4.5 cold re-verification (2026-07-25T18:24:48Z, Note 1). Under bare 'mix spec.check' the tagged_tests verification leg intermittently red-lights on three tests — test/specled_ex/verifier_test.exs:1452, :1681 and test/specled_ex/review_test.exs:135 — when the machine is loaded. All three passed on an immediate re-run and in isolation. Not attributable to dn4.5.

This is a THIRD flake class in this codebase's gate path, after specled_-ya8 (async code-server mutation, FIXED) and specled_-zr6 (StreamData generator space, open). Unlike zr6 it is load-sensitive rather than seed-sensitive, so it strikes exactly when the machine is busy — i.e. during parallel orchestration, which is when a red gate is most expensive.

Fix direction: serialize these three or widen their timing budget; commits c478563 (ya8) and d300c21 already hardened neighboring tests and are the pattern to follow.

Out of the dn4 epic (pre-existing; no gate blocked). If it red-lights two dn4 merge gates it should be escalated in like ya8 was.

comments.text:
New data point for this flaky class, observed 2026-07-25 while working specled_-cz0 on branch specled_-cz0/spec-honesty.

`mix spec.check` failed once in five runs, same session, no edits between runs:

  validate status=fail errors=1 warnings=0
  [ERROR] specled.package verification_command_failed .spec/specs/package.spec.md ::
    Verification command failed: tagged_tests: mix test --include integration ...
  failing tests: test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs:255
  spec.check result=fail tier=validate error_findings=1

Adds a file to this ticket's list, which so far names verifier_test.exs:1452/:1681 and review_test.exs:135.

What did NOT reproduce it (all green, exit 0):
  - mix test (full, no --include) x3
  - mix test --include integration (full suite)
  - mix test --include integration test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs (isolated)
  - mix spec.check x4 (the other four of the five)

Detail worth noting for whoever picks this up: line 255 is not a test declaration in that file. The tests bracket it at 250 ("a fabricated, unmarked finding code IS flagged") and 256/257 ("the evidence/* and cross_field/* families are guarded in both directions"); 255 is blank. Whatever emits the `failing tests:` line is reporting a line that does not correspond to a test declaration, which may be a lead on the reporting path rather than on the tests themselves.

Mechanism ruled out: a cwd race against the lint's relative corpus globs (`.spec/**/*.md`, `docs/**/*.md`). The only three File.cd! sites in the suite — binding_test.exs, coverage_closure_test.exs, spec_check_test.exs — are all async: false and carry comments saying exactly why, and ExUnit does not overlap sync modules with async ones.

The two tests bracketing line 255 are pure-constant assertions with no filesystem or process access, so neither can be load-sensitive on its own.

IMPLEMENTED
Session: 0a000e53-c6f4-4a90-9dbd-92b67b44eaf1
Log: /Users/mz/.claude-remembers/projects/-Users-mz-src-specled-ex/0a000e53-c6f4-4a90-9dbd-92b67b44eaf1.jsonl

Commit: d032ff0 (branch specled_-odl/load-fragile-tagged-tests)
Files touched: test/test_helper.exs, test/specled_ex/verifier_test.exs, test/specled_ex/review_test.exs
Tests added: none (test-infrastructure hardening of existing tests)
Verification stubs flipped: none
Verification tier: change-scoped — mix test --include integration on verifier_test.exs + review_test.exs + docs_identifier_lint_test.exs (92 tests, 0 failures), mix compile --warnings-as-errors, mix format --check-formatted, mix spec.check --no-run-commands (result=pass with Spec-Drift: test_only trailer); full-system proof deferred to the merge gate / PR CI
Final-tier runs: 1

Summary: Three defenses against the load-flake class: (1) suite per-test ExUnit timeout 60s -> 120s in test_helper.exs — under orchestration load, subprocess-heavy tests slow far more than CPU-bound ones and the 60s kill converted machine load into red gates; the leg's 400s command budget still bounds real hangs. (2) The seven timeout-classification shim budgets in verifier_test.exs consolidated into @timeout_shim_budget_ms and widened 2000ms -> 4000ms (d300c21's spawn-race margin, doubled after the 1681 observation beat it). (3) ReviewTest serialized (async: false) to keep its per-test git spawns out of the async phase's fork burst, per c478563's pattern. Costs ~20s of bare spec.check runtime; cheap tiers unaffected.

Mechanism note: no failure output was ever captured from the observed flakes, so the mechanism is inferred (ExUnit 60s kill / spawn-latency race / fork pressure all fit; a 6-iteration synthetic-load repro at ~2x slowdown stayed green). The docs_identifier_lint_test.exs:255 reporting anomaly (line maps to no test declaration) could not be explained by the descriptor path, which only emits ExUnit declaration lines — follow-up specled_-td7 adds self-identifying descriptors (event id alongside file:line) and recommends setting SPECLED_COMMAND_OUTPUT_DIR in gate environments so the next occurrence is diagnosable.

title: Load-fragile tagged_tests leg: verifier_test.exs:1452/:1681 and review_test.exs:135 intermittently fail under machine load
